messages:
maria: Quick preflight for tomorrow's DevEx release (10:00 PDT). Short checklist — please reply with one of: `ok`, `blocker <short reason>`, or `ETA <time>`.

- SDK RC (owner: @aj) — PRs merged? any CI flakes? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/512
- Docs + changelog (owner: @lee) — final wording, product signoff? changelog cutoff = EOD today
- Sample apps (owner: @sasha) — quickstarts updated, container images published?
- Quickstarts CI (owner: @ben) — smoke tests, e2e pass?
- Release automation / tag/publish (ops: @devops-bot) — window reserved?

maria: I'll triage blockers and run a 15m sync if >1 blocker reported.

aj: SDK RC status: most green. There's a Windows runner flake in integration-ci, failing ~1/30 runs. I have a fix branch, will land in ~2h if no surprises. PR 512 is the RC; changelog entry included. I can run npm publish after docs signoff.

lee: Docs/changelog: draft at https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/changelog/draft-2.1.1.md. Left a note on breaking-change wording — product confirm pls. Pushed a tiny quickstart walkthrough typo fix.

sasha: Sample apps: updated 3/4 apps. The electron demo image failed publish due to CI token expiry; rotating token now — ETA 5pm PT to republish. Quickstarts using hosted images blocked until then.

ben: QA: smoke tests on stable artifacts passed (sanity + perf sanity). Found flaky auth test (test-342) intermittently failing on CI — bisecting, suspect race in mock server teardown. If I can't stabilize by 3pm PT I'll add a skip and do post-release fix.

taylor: Product: prefer wording "legacy auth" instead of "deprecated auth" for customer tone. After that I can sign off.

devops-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC — resources: release-orbit-runner-2. If you need to extend, file infra ticket now.

aj: Thanks @devops-bot. I can publish npm after @lee signoff and @maria go. Ben, if you need to skip test-342 say so now; don't want to ship with known flaky affecting customers.

ben: Trying to stabilize; will update by 15:00 PT. If >2h I'll request skip.

sasha: Token rotated, re-publishing demo image now — pushing 3 images, ETA ~16:30 PT.

lee: Updated wording to "legacy auth" and pushed changelog commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ab12cd3. Docs ready.

aj: Landed windows flake fix in RC branch and re-ran CI. All green. PR 512 merged to release branch. Holding npm publish until final thumbs.

ben: Stabilized test-342 with teardown wait; tests passing locally and CI in progress. Will not skip if CI holds.

maria: Quick summary:
- SDK RC: merged, npm publish pending final thumbs
- Docs: signoff from @taylor and @lee done
- Sample apps: images republished, @sasha -> done at ~16:29 PT
- QA: tests passing, @ben not skipping
- Devops: window reserved

If nobody reports a blocker in 30m I'll publish release artifacts and we proceed with the reserved window. Any last-minute changes? Include PR link if so.

aj: ok
lee: ok
sasha: ok
ben: ok
taylor: ok

maria: Going to run publish steps and post release notes link once live. Thanks all :party_parrot:
